A '''shield operator''' was a crew specialization aboard a [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. Their primary function was to operate the [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] systems aboard spacecraft. During combat, the operators were responsible for maintaining the shield functions of their vessels against incoming enemy fire.<ref name="RPG" />
